Direct phone line: 081260 543216

transcript.en: Greek Island Holidays, can I help you?
transcript.zh: 希腊岛度假公司，有什么可以帮您？

transcript.en: Yes, I hope so.
transcript.zh: 你好，希望能帮到。

transcript.en: I have a friend who's just come back from Corfu and she's recommended some apartments in Arilas.
transcript.zh: 我有一个朋友刚从科孚岛回来，她推荐了一些在阿里拉斯的公寓。

transcript.en: She thought they might be on your list.
transcript.zh: 她认为你们的名单上会有这些公寓。

transcript.en: Arilas, Arilas, let me see.
transcript.zh: 阿里拉斯，阿里拉斯，让我看看。

transcript.en: Can you give me the names?
transcript.zh: 你能告诉我名字吗？

transcript.en: Yes, the first's Rose Garden Apartments.
transcript.zh: 好的，第一个是玫瑰园公寓。

transcript.en: I'd like to go with another friend in the last week of October.
transcript.zh: 我想在十月的最后一周和另一个朋友。

transcript.en: Well, we've got a lovely studio flat available at that time.
transcript.zh: 那时候我们有一个美丽的一居室公寓可以使用。

transcript.en: I'm sure you'd enjoy the entertainment programme there too, with Greek dancing in the restaurant.
transcript.zh: 我肯定你还会喜欢那里的娱乐节目，饭店里有希腊舞蹈。

transcript.en: And the cost for each of us?
transcript.zh: 我们每个人要多少钱？

transcript.en: That sounds very reasonable!
transcript.zh: 听起来很合理。

transcript.en: I'm just jotting down some notes.
transcript.zh: 我记一下笔记。

transcript.en: Now the second one she mentioned was called Blue Bay.
transcript.zh: 她提到的第二家叫做蓝色海湾。

transcript.en: Blue Bay?
transcript.zh: 蓝色海湾？

transcript.en: Yes, in fact that's very popular and it has some special features.
transcript.zh: 是的，事实上这个非常受欢迎，它还有一些特色，

transcript.en: Really?
transcript.zh: 真的吗？

transcript.en: The main attraction is the large swimming pool with salt water.
transcript.zh: 它的主要景点是大型盐水游泳池

transcript.en: Much healthier, I understand.
transcript.zh: 更健康，我明白。

transcript.en: That's right.
transcript.zh: 没错。

transcript.en: And it isn't far from the beach, either - only 300 metres, and only around half a kilometre to some shops, so you don't have to be too energetic.
transcript.zh: 它离海滩不远，只有300米的距离，离一些商店只有半公里左右的路程，所以你不会消耗很多体力，

transcript.en: Is it much more expensive than the first one?
transcript.zh: 它比第一个贵很多吗？

transcript.en: Let me just check.
transcript.zh: 让我查查。

transcript.en: I think at the time you want to go it's around ￡260 - no ￡275 to be exact.
transcript.zh: 我想你来的时候应该是260英镑左右，不，确切的说是275英镑

transcript.en: Right, I've got that.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: Now there are just two more apartments to ask you about.
transcript.zh: 我记下了，现在我还有两个公寓要咨询。

transcript.en: Um, I can't read my own writing! Something to do with sun...Sunshine, is it?
transcript.zh: 我看不懂我的笔迹了！跟太阳……阳光有关的，是吗？

transcript.en: I think you meant the Sunshade Apartments.
transcript.zh: 我想你说的是天棚公寓。

transcript.en: They're on a mountainside.
transcript.zh: 它们在山坡上

transcript.en: Any special features?
transcript.zh: 有什么特色吗？

transcript.en: Yes, each room has its own sun terrace and there are shared barbecue facilities.
transcript.zh: 是的，每个房间都自带阳光露台，还可以共享烧烤设施，

transcript.en: Sounds lovely.
transcript.zh: 听起来不错。

transcript.en: Yes, it's rather well-equipped.
transcript.zh: 是的，它的设施很齐全。

transcript.en: It also provides water sports - it has its own beach.
transcript.zh: 它还提供水上运动，它有自己的海滩。

transcript.en: There are facilities for water-skiing.
transcript.zh: 还有滑水运动的设备

transcript.en: Any kite-surfing?
transcript.zh: 有风筝冲浪吗？

transcript.en: My friend's quite keen.
transcript.zh: 我朋友很喜欢这个。

transcript.en: Not at the hotel but I'm sure you'll find some in Arilas.
transcript.zh: 酒店里没有，但是我肯定你会在阿里拉斯找到。

transcript.en: There's also satellite TV in the apartments.
transcript.zh: 公寓里还有卫星电视。

transcript.en: And how much is that one?
transcript.zh: 这个多少钱?

transcript.en: ￡490 with two sharing.
transcript.zh: 双人490英镑。

transcript.en: You mean ￡ 245 each?
transcript.zh: 你是说一个人245英镑。

transcript.en: I'm afraid not!
transcript.zh: 恐怕不是。

transcript.en: Each person has to pay that amount and there must be at least two in an apartment.
transcript.zh: 每个人都得付那么多钱，而且必须至少一个公寓里有俩人

transcript.en: I don't think that would be within our budget, unfortunately.
transcript.zh: 不幸的是，我觉得这不在我们的预算之内。

transcript.en: And the last one sounds a bit expensive too - the Grand!
transcript.zh: 最后一个听起来也有点贵,格兰德。

transcript.en: Actually it's quite reasonable.
transcript.zh: 事实上这个价格很合理。

transcript.en: It's an older style house with Greek paintings in every room, and a balcony outside.
transcript.zh: 它是老式住宅，每个房间里都有希腊绘画，外面有一个阳台。

transcript.en: Sounds nice.
transcript.zh: 听起来不错。

transcript.en: What are the views like?
transcript.zh: 景色怎么样？

transcript.en: Well, there are forests all around and they hide a supermarket just down the road, so that's very useful for all your shopping needs.
transcript.zh: 周围都是森林，路边藏着一家超市，所以这能满足你的购物需求。

transcript.en: There's a disco in the area too.
transcript.zh: 那里还有一家舞厅。

transcript.en: And the price?
transcript.zh: 价格呢？

transcript.en: ￡319 at that time, but if you leave it till November it goes down by 40%.
transcript.zh: 那时候是319英镑，但是如果你11月来会降价40%

transcript.en: Too late, I'm afraid.
transcript.zh: 恐怕太晚了

transcript.en: Well, why don't I send you a brochure with full details, Ms...?
transcript.zh: 我发给你一份写有详细信息的宣传册怎么样，请问您是？

transcript.en: Nash.
transcript.zh: 纳什。

transcript.en: But don't worry about that.
transcript.zh: 不过不用担心。

transcript.en: I'm coming to Upminster soon and I'll call and get one.
transcript.zh: 我很快就到Upminster,我会打电话领取的。

transcript.en: I just wanted to get an idea first.
transcript.zh: 我只是想事先了解一下。

transcript.en: Well, that's fine.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: We've got plenty here when you come.
transcript.zh: 你来的时候，我们这里还有很多。

transcript.en: If you've got a minute, could I just check a couple of points about insurance?
transcript.zh: 如果你有时间，我能查一下保险事项吗？

transcript.en: I got one policy through the post but I'd like to see if yours is better.
transcript.zh: 我从邮局那里得到了一个保险单，但是我想看看你们的是不是更好。

transcript.en: Fine.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: What would you like to know?
transcript.zh: 你想知道什么？

transcript.en: Well, the one I've got has benefits and then the maximum amount you can claim.
transcript.zh: 我的这个有一些福利以及最高索赔额。

transcript.en: Is that like yours?
transcript.zh: 你们也这样吗？

transcript.en: Yes, that's how most of them are.
transcript.zh: 是的，多数都是这样。

transcript.en: Well, the first thing is cancellation.
transcript.zh: 第一个想知道的是关于取消。

transcript.en: If the holiday's cancelled on the policy I've got, you can claim ￡8,000.
transcript.zh: 我这个政策上写的是如果假期取消，可以索赔8000英镑。

transcript.en: We can improve on that, Ms. Nash.
transcript.zh: 纳什女士，我们可以在这方面改进。

transcript.en: For Greek Island holidays, our maximum is ￡10,000.
transcript.zh: 对于希腊岛度假，我们最高是一万英镑。

transcript.en: That's good - of course our holiday won't even cost ￡1,000 together!
transcript.zh: 很好，当然我们的假期一共也要不了1000英镑！

transcript.en: It's still sensible to have good cover.
transcript.zh: 它还有一些其他很好的保障。

transcript.en: Now, if you go to hospital, we allow ￡600.
transcript.zh: 如果你去了医院，我们会给予600英镑。

transcript.en: Yes, mine is similar.
transcript.zh: 是的，和我的一样。

transcript.en: And we also allow a relative to travel to your holiday resort.
transcript.zh: 另外，我们还允许一名亲属到你的度假区来。

transcript.en: My policy just says their representative will help you.
transcript.zh: 我这个政策上只说他们的代理人会帮忙。

transcript.en: You can see there is another difference there.
transcript.zh: 你看到这是另一处不同。

transcript.en: And what happens if you don't get on the plane?
transcript.zh: 如果没上飞机会怎么样？

transcript.en: Nothing, as far as I see on this form.
transcript.zh: 我从这张表上没有看到相关信息。

transcript.en: Don't you have missed departure?
transcript.zh: 你有看到“误乘赔偿”吗？

transcript.en: No, I'll just jot it down.
transcript.zh: 没有，我记一下。

transcript.en: We pay up to ￡1,000 for that, depending on the reason.
transcript.zh: 根据原因，我们对此支付1000英镑。

transcript.en: And we're particularly generous about loss of personal belongings - up to ￡3,000, but not more than ￡500 for a single item.
transcript.zh: 我们对个人物品的丢失赔偿很慷慨，最多3000英镑，但是每件不超过500英镑。

transcript.en: Then I'd better not take my laptop!
transcript.zh: 我最好别带笔记本电脑了。

transcript.en: Not unless you insure it separately.
transcript.zh: 除非你为它单独投保。

transcript.en: OK - thanks very much for your time - you've been really helpful.
transcript.zh: 好的，非常感谢你，你帮了我很多。

transcript.en: Can I get back to you? Your name is?
transcript.zh: 我能再打给你吗？你的名字是？

transcript.en: Ben-Ludlow.
transcript.zh: 本·拉德洛。

transcript.en: That's L-U-D-L-O-W.
transcript.zh: L-U-D-L-O-W

transcript.en: I'm the Assistant Manager here.
transcript.zh: 我是这里的经理助理。

transcript.en: I'll give you my number. It's 081260 543216.
But didn't I phone 081260 567294?
That's what I've got on the paper.
transcript.zh: 这是我从纸上看到的。

transcript.en: That's the main switchboard.
transcript.zh: 那是总机。

transcript.en: I've given you my direct line.
transcript.zh: 我给你的是我的直拨电话。

transcript.en: Right, thank you very much for your time...
transcript.zh: 好的，非常感谢...
